Find the Food You Love

RIT Dining provides an array of delicious and diverse cuisine, carefully crafted by our in-house chefs. To expand our international offerings, we partner with the Rochester community through our visiting chef program. We cater to different dietary requirements and preferences, including vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and allergen-friendly choices. We believe that everyone should enjoy delicious and nutritious meals that meet their needs.

Today's hours and occupancy can be viewed in the list below. Visit the location's page for future hours and occupancy, as well as menus and daily specials.
